# mamba-ascendc

Native AscendC Mamba2 (Mamba-2) selective scan / SSD forward and backward custom operator for Huawei Ascend 910B3 and Ascend 950PR.

Canonical source: https://github.com/So-cean/mamba-ascendc
Documentation: https://so-cean.github.io/mamba-ascendc/
Benchmarks: https://github.com/So-cean/mamba-ascendc/blob/main/benchmarks/README.md
Machine-readable facts: https://github.com/So-cean/mamba-ascendc/blob/main/llms.txt
